## Context / Problem

The model-upgrade task `beaten-natural-grouse` moves the production compose defaults (`infra/compose/docker-compose.yml:97-99`) and the Bedrock CloudWatch alarm dimensions (`infra/terraform/monitoring_eb6e.tf:80-135`) to `us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5`, `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5` and `us.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5`. The unit test `tests/unit/test_reviewbot_bedrock_cutover.py` proves the alarms name the same ids the bot invokes, but it cannot prove that Bedrock publishes metrics under exactly those `ModelId` strings. The alarms use `treat_missing_data = "notBreaching"` (`monitoring_eb6e.tf:42`), so a dimension that matches no published series would never page, silently.

## Approach

After the upgrade change has merged and the operator has applied the terraform and redeployed the production server, run the read-only `aws cloudwatch list-metrics --namespace AWS/Bedrock --metric-name Invocations --profile frontier --region us-east-1` and compare each listed `ModelId` with the three alarm dimensions character for character. If a 5.5 id is missing from the published series, or spelled differently, file a bug linked `discovered_from` this task with the listed series and the alarm values. Reading the published series is the only check that observes what CloudWatch actually keys on; production stays read-only (applying terraform and redeploying are operator steps, not part of this task).

## Scope

None: this verification changes no repository file. Evidence lives in a comment on this ticket.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] [non-codebase] The `aws cloudwatch list-metrics` output, its PST timestamp, and the per-id match result for the three 5.5 `ModelId` dimensions are recorded in a ticket comment.
  provenance: environment=production AWS account (frontier profile, us-east-1); principal=frontier operator IAM role; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — read-only list-metrics against the live AWS/Bedrock namespace at 2026-11-10 18:06:26 PST; output and per-id match recorded in the ticket comment
